transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic, can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I’ve just had this absolutely incredible surge of energy and an extremely elevated mood for the past five months, and I feel like I can do absolutely anything! I’m constantly on the move and starting a million projects, so honestly, I’m feeling way too good to even be sitting still in this office right now.
Have you experienced any periods of feeling extremely low or depressed, either before this surge of energy began or at any other point in your life?
No, I haven't really experienced periods of feeling low or depressed at all. My energy has just been completely through the roof, and I feel far too amazing to ever feel down.
Do you often find yourself having trouble focusing on one task, getting easily distracted, or acting on impulse without thinking things through?

Yes, definitely. My attention is constantly jumping to every little thing around me, like a random noise or someone walking by. It makes it impossible to focus, so I keep starting new tasks and switching between them without ever finishing a single one.

During these episodes of high energy and decreased focus, do you experience any notable changes in your judgment, such as engaging in reckless or impulsive behaviors that could have serious consequences?

I haven't really noticed engaging in any reckless or impulsive behaviors myself. Everything I do feels perfectly reasonable and under control to me, so I'm not really sure if my actions would be considered reckless by others.
How have your relationships, work, or school performance been affected by your high energy levels and difficulty with focus over the past five months?

Honestly, I've been so busy starting all these exciting new projects that I haven't really stopped to think about how it's affecting my work or relationships. I feel so incredibly energetic and capable of anything right now, so I haven't really noticed any issues.
Can you estimate how many days in a row you've experienced this extremely elevated mood and high energy level without any significant breaks or returns to a normal mood?

I've felt this way continuously every single day for about five months now. There haven't been any breaks or moments where I went back to how I used to be. It's just been one long, non-stop rush of incredible energy.
Do you experience any significant disturbances in your sleep patterns, such as needing much less sleep than usual, or any changes in your appetite or eating habits?

Oh, I barely sleep at all—maybe two or three hours a night—but I wake up feeling completely refreshed, energized, and don't feel the need for more sleep at all! It's definitely not a problem because I have so much to do. As for my appetite, I haven't really noticed any changes or paid much attention to eating.
Have you ever experienced any psychotic symptoms, such as hallucinations or delusions, during these episodes of high energy and elevated mood?

Yes, absolutely, but only when my energy is this high. During these times, I've heard voices that others can't hear and felt a powerful certainty that I have special, unique abilities and a grand purpose. These experiences never happen to me unless I'm in one of these high-energy states.

Can you describe the relationship between your high-energy episodes and the psychotic symptoms, such as the voices and feelings of special abilities, in more detail, and whether these symptoms occur exclusively during the high-energy episodes or also at other times?

The voices and the feelings of having special abilities only happen when I am in these high-energy, elevated states. As soon as my energy levels return to normal, those unusual experiences and beliefs completely disappear. They never occur at any other time.

Have you experienced any periods where the psychotic symptoms, such as the voices or delusions, occurred without the accompanying high-energy and elevated mood, or have the psychotic symptoms always been closely tied to the manic-like episodes?

No, they have never occurred on their own. The voices and beliefs are always completely tied to my high-energy episodes and never happen when my mood is normal. They only show up when I'm feeling this elevated and energized.
